class_name: 限定-選択肢なし-イガイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: A formal noun setting the named thing aside from the rest: it takes a noun through の (この店のほか) and a plain dictionary-form verb directly (そうするほかない). The particle after it sets the direction: のほかに／のほかも adds a second item, のほかは with a negative sets everything else aside, and のほかに with a negative narrows to one (彼のほかにいない). Class sibling 以外 clamps onto the bare noun and is the Sino-formal, exclusionary member.

examples.ruby: この店[みせ]では和菓子[わがし]のほかに洋菓子[ようがし]も売[う]っている。
examples.english: Besides Japanese sweets, this shop also sells Western-style pastries.

examples.ruby: 祖父[そふ]のほかに、この時計[とけい]を直[なお]せる人[ひと]はいない。
examples.english: Apart from my grandfather, there's nobody who can fix this clock.

examples.ruby: 弟[おとうと]は犬[いぬ]のほかに、金魚[きんぎょ]も三匹[さんびき]飼[か]っている。
examples.english: Besides the dog, my little brother keeps three goldfish.

patterns.usage_note: Draws an exclusion line around a noun or a whole action: everything but the thing named. It attaches directly to a bare noun with no の, and to a plain dictionary-form verb (謝る以外に方法がない). Class sibling ほか needs の before a noun and leans additive ('besides'); 以外 is the Sino-formal, explicitly exclusionary member and the default in set phrases like それ以外. With a following negative it hardens into 'nothing but'.

examples.ruby: 日曜日[にちようび]以外[いがい]は、朝[あさ]六時[ろくじ]に起[お]きています。
examples.english: Except on Sundays, I'm up at six in the morning.

examples.ruby: もう一度[いちど]謝[あやま]る以外[いがい]に、方法[ほうほう]はないだろう。
examples.english: There's probably nothing for it but to apologize one more time.

examples.ruby: 試験中[しけんちゅう]は鉛筆[えんぴつ]以外[いがい]は机[つくえ]の上[うえ]に置[お]かないでください。
examples.english: During the exam, please keep everything but your pencil off the desk.
